In order to complete the official publishing and filing formalities with the Enterprise Court Registry and the Belgian Official Gazette for your company, we require your formal authorization.

We have prepared a special power of attorney which allows our firm to sign, submit, and publish these documents on your behalf. This saves you the need to handle these tedious administrative submissions yourself.

Please review and sign electronically the attached Power of Attorney, clicking the link below.

Please ensure that you check the accuracy of the details. Once signed, our team will immediately proceed with the court filing.

If you have any questions, please do not hesitate to contact us.

To ensure we can effectively manage your ongoing payroll, personnel administration, or insurance files for your company, we need to communicate directly with your external providers on your behalf.

In accordance with GDPR and professional confidentiality policies, your service providers require a formal mandate/letter of authority before they can release pay slips, payroll summaries, social contribution data, or policy details to us.

We have prepared this simple 3rd-party liaison mandate. Please review and sign it electronically so we can seamlessly collect and reconcile these necessary documents on your behalf.

Please note: This is a read-access and data-exchange authorization only. It does not grant our firm any executive or decision-making power over your payroll or contract policies.

If you have any questions, feel free to reach out.

To automate your day-to-day accounting and secure our billing process, we require your authorization an essential banking service for you:

The SEPA Direct Debit Mandate: This authorizes our firm to automatically collect our recurring monthly fees as agreed in our Engagement Letter, removing the need for you to manually process each of our invoices.

Please review and sign electronically the attached joint SEPA authorization document, clicking the link below.

Note: Bank activation for electronic feedstypically takes 5 to 10 business days. We will notify you once the automatic sync is active.

Thank you for your help in setting this up.
